Microsoft expanded 'People Skills' (AI-inferred skills from Microsoft 365 activity) across more users and surfaces for workforce insights and learning/talent experiences. Skills Agent removed for new installs.

Results: 10,000 hours saved per quarter, 750% increase in interviews scheduled, 30% faster screening.

ServiceNow's March 2026 HRSD Store Release introduced AI-agentic interview self-scheduling V2, generative onboarding ramp-up plan builder, Voice Agents for HRSD V3.0 with 8-language support, AI-generated offboarding knowledge transfer plan, and employee feedback agentic flows.

Ace Hardware deployed Workday's Paradox Conversational ATS (post-acquisition), automating up to 90% of hiring tasks from screening to onboarding via text-based AI conversation, achieving an 86% candidate conversation rate.
PNC Financial's CIO described AI workforce upskilling as a 2026 priority, equipping employees with AI tools across the organization as part of broader responsible AI adoption efforts.

Workday announced that customers including 7-Eleven and Ace Hardware deployed the Workday Paradox Candidate Experience Agent and Paradox Conversational ATS, automating up to 90% of hiring tasks. Early customers reported conversion rates above 70% and time-to-hire as fast as 3.5 days.
KeyCorp's CIO described accelerated AI talent and upskilling investment as a central 2026 workforce priority.
U.S. Bancorp's CIO described ensuring the right skills for responsible AI adoption as a 2026 workforce priority.

The U.S. Department of Labor launched 'Make America AI-Ready,' a free AI literacy course delivered by text message (built with Arist) to build foundational AI skills for workers.

Workday launched Sana from Workday, a conversational AI interface built on its $1.1B acquisition of Sana Labs. Includes Sana Self-Service Agent with 300+ skills for HR and finance tasks, Sana Enterprise for cross-system orchestration, and AI Agent Studio for custom agent development. Now available to all Workday customers worldwide via Flex Credits.

Workday's Spring 2026 release delivers a new wave of AI Agents for HR including a Talent Management Agent (Early Access) that drafts evidence-based performance reviews using real-time contribution signals, plus new AI capabilities for hiring, compensation, and employee listening. Also launched Workday Data Cloud expansion.

Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Release 26A delivers new AI agents across Core HR, Talent Management, and Workforce Management. Includes Employee Concierge AI subagents for absence/benefits/comp/payroll, Journeys Assistant for onboarding, AI-powered candidate authenticity scoring for recruiting, Payroll Run Analyst agent, and Employee Goals Assistant for conversational goal creation.

Oracle HCM 26A introduces AI-powered candidate authenticity scoring to identify fraudulent or AI-generated applicants, plus AI Agent Studio integration for recruiters during offer creation using uploaded policies and prompts. GenAI capabilities added for note and approval fields across HR workflows.

ChartHop's AI-powered people operations platform, including the new ChartHop AI Pro with agentic actions and custom AI agents, is now available on the SAP Store. Integration with SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central delivers unified workforce intelligence, headcount planning, and real-time people analytics with AI-powered insights.

Korn Ferry's 2026 TA Trends Report notes Microsoft is issuing security IDs to AI agents and building infrastructure for human-AI hybrid teams, with 52% of talent leaders planning to add autonomous AI agents to their teams in 2026.
